name: Tooling & Build Systems
description: Frontend development toolchain: package managers, Vite and Webpack bundlers, transpilers (Babel/SWC), linters and formatters, Git workflows, monorepo tooling, CI/CD pipelines, Module Federation for micro-frontends, and developer experience optimization.

subskills.name: Package Managers
subskills.description: npm, yarn, pnpm — lockfiles, workspaces, peer dependencies, resolution strategies.

subskills.name: Vite
subskills.description: Vite native ESM dev server, esbuild pre-bundling, HMR, Rollup-based production builds, plugin API.

subskills.name: Webpack
subskills.description: Webpack loaders, plugins, code splitting (dynamic import), chunk optimization, bundle analysis.

subskills.name: Transpilers & Polyfills
subskills.description: Babel presets/plugins, SWC, browserslist targets, core-js polyfills, syntax downleveling.

subskills.name: Linters & Formatters
subskills.description: ESLint flat config, Prettier, Stylelint, lint-staged, pre-commit hooks, custom rules.

subskills.name: Git Workflows
subskills.description: Git Flow vs trunk-based, conventional commits, semantic versioning, pre-commit hooks, changelogs.

subskills.name: Monorepo Tools
subskills.description: Turborepo, Nx, shared packages, dependency graph, parallel task execution, caching.

subskills.name: CI/CD for Frontend
subskills.description: GitHub Actions, preview deployments, Lighthouse CI, automated testing in pipelines, artifact caching.

subskills.name: Module Federation
subskills.description: Webpack Module Federation, micro-frontend architecture, shared dependencies, runtime integration.

subskills.name: Developer Experience
subskills.description: Hot reload, source maps, dev proxies, environment variables, editor integration (VS Code extensions).

github.signal: Git hooks or conventional commits setup

linkedin.signal: Webpack, Vite, or build tools endorsed
CI/CD or DevOps for frontend endorsed

junior.description: Manages dependencies, configures linters, follows branching strategies, and maintains productive dev environments.

mid.description: Configures bundlers for optimal output, sets up transpilation targets, and builds CI/CD pipelines with preview deploys.

senior.description: Architects monorepo structures with shared packages and implements micro-frontend architectures with runtime module loading.
